title: Client-side LLM cost selection must mirror server-side cost translation per backend
answers: which tracking backends compute LLM trace cost on the client
traces missing cost on SageMaker or Databricks MLflow
where is cost calculated for spans sent to a tracking server
add cost support for a new tracking backend
body:
Invariant: the client computes span cost only when should_compute_cost_client_side() is True (mlflow/tracing/utils/__init__.py:should_compute_cost_client_side). It returns True for Databricks and SageMaker tracking URIs. All other backends get cost from translate_span_when_storing, called in SqlAlchemyStore._log_spans_once.
If a backend skips server-side cost translation, add it to this selector. Otherwise its spans get no LLM_COST.
The SageMaker detection lives in mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri, but the selector decides, so new URI kinds need a change in both places.
Tests should run the real selector through LiveSpan.end() (test_sagemaker_cost_computed_when_span_ends in tests/tracing/utils/test_utils.py). Mock only the tracking URI and pricing, not the selector.
applies: Any change to which backends compute LLM cost, or to where cost is computed in the tracing SDK or server store.
says: LLM trace runs on SageMaker tracking servers are missing estimated cost metrics.
Spans logged to our Databricks tracking server show empty cost values.
Track LLM spend for model spans when using custom tracking server backends.
Why do trace details omit token cost when logged to Amazon SageMaker?
Calculate estimated inference costs for traces on newly configured tracking backends.
search: Client-side LLM span cost calculation is restricted to Databricks and SageMaker tracking backends via should_compute_cost_client_side in mlflow/tracing/utils/__init__.py, while other backends rely on server-side translate_span_when_storing in SqlAlchemyStore._log_spans_once. Backends skipping server-side translation must be registered in both the client selector and mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri to avoid missing LLM_COST. Tests in tests/tracing/utils/test_utils.py:test_sagemaker_cost_computed_when_span_ends should exercise LiveSpan.end() with real selector logic, mocking only tracking URI and pricing.
